<!-- Generated by docs/scripts/gen-reference.mjs from `proof --experimental-dump-help`. Do not edit. -->

Add `--json` to any command to get its result as one JSON object on stdout. Progress messages still go
to stderr, so stdout is always valid JSON. The exit code is the same as without `--json`.

Optional fields (marked `?`) are left out when they have no value. Paths in examples are shortened;
real output has absolute paths.

| Type | Printed by |
|---|---|
| [`MessageReport`](#messagereport) | [`proof init`](../commands/init/), [`proof doctor`](../commands/doctor/), [`proof run`](../commands/run/), [`proof ui`](../commands/ui/), [`proof snap`](../commands/snap/), [`proof record`](../commands/record/), [`proof flow`](../commands/flow/), [`proof video`](../commands/video/), [`proof ax`](../commands/ax/), [`proof packet`](../commands/packet/) with `--clear` |
| [`BriefResult`](#briefresult) | [`proof build`](../commands/build/), [`proof brief`](../commands/brief/), [`proof test`](../commands/test/), [`proof run`](../commands/run/) |
| [`StackReport`](#stackreport) | [`proof test`](../commands/test/) with `--stack` |
| [`FlowRunReport`](#flowrunreport) | [`proof flow run`](../commands/flow/) |
| [`StackFlowReport`](#stackflowreport) | [`proof flow run`](../commands/flow/) with `--stack` |
| [`TreeReport`](#treereport) | [`proof ui tree`](../commands/ui/) |
| [`AtReport`](#atreport) | [`proof ui at`](../commands/ui/) |
| [`AXScanReport`](#axscanreport) | [`proof ax scan`](../commands/ax/) |
| [`PRCommentsReport`](#prcommentsreport) | [`proof pr comments`](../commands/pr/) |
| [`PacketReport`](#packetreport) | [`proof packet`](../commands/packet/) |
| [`StopReport`](#stopreport) | [`proof stop`](../commands/stop/) |
| [`InstallResult`](#installresult) | [`proof setup`](../commands/setup/) |

## MessageReport

A result that is just a message. Most commands that act on something return this.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ok` | `boolean` | `false` when the command found a problem (for example `doctor`, `flow check`). |
| `message` | `string` | The same text the command prints without `--json`. |

```json
{
  "message": "tapped button #timer.start \"Start\"",
  "ok": true
}
```

## BriefResult

A condensed `xcodebuild` result, for builds and tests.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `status` | `string` | `succeeded`, `failed` or `unknown`. |
| `action` | `string` | `build`, `test`, or `output` for `proof brief`. |
| `errors` | `Diagnostic[]` | Each distinct error, with its location. |
| `warningCount` | `number` | How many warnings there were. |
| `warnings` | `Diagnostic[]?` | Only with `--warnings`. |
| `tests` | `TestSummary?` | Only for tests. |
| `duration` | `number?` | Seconds. |
| `tail` | `string[]?` | The last lines of raw output, when the run failed and no error was recognised. |

**Diagnostic**

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `kind` | `string` | `error` or `warning`. |
| `file` | `string?` | Path relative to the repository root. |
| `line` | `number?` |  |
| `column` | `number?` |  |
| `message` | `string` |  |

**TestSummary**

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `passed` | `number` |  |
| `failed` | `number` |  |
| `skipped` | `number` |  |
| `failures` | `TestFailure[]` | Each failing test: `test` (`Class/testName`), `file?`, `line?`, `message?` (the assertion). |

```json
{
  "action": "build",
  "duration": 38.2,
  "errors": [
    {
      "column": 17,
      "file": "Modules/Timer/Sources/TimerView.swift",
      "kind": "error",
      "line": 42,
      "message": "cannot find 'viewModel' in scope"
    }
  ],
  "status": "failed",
  "warningCount": 3
}
```

```json
{
  "action": "test",
  "duration": 61.4,
  "errors": [],
  "status": "failed",
  "tests": {
    "failed": 1,
    "failures": [
      {
        "file": "Tests/TimerTests.swift",
        "line": 57,
        "message": "XCTAssertEqual failed: (\"25\") is not equal to (\"15\")",
        "test": "TimerTests/testPresetPersists"
      }
    ],
    "passed": 181,
    "skipped": 2
  },
  "warningCount": 0
}
```

## StackReport

One test result per branch of a stack, bottom to top.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `branches` | `BranchRun[]` | Each branch: `branch`, `sha`, `result` (a BriefResult) and `pr` (its PR number, when known). |
| `introduced` | `object` | Failing test (or `build`) → the first branch where it fails. That is where to fix it. |
| `skipped` | `string[]` | Branches not run, because of `--stop-on-fail` or `proof stop`. |

```json
{
  "branches": [
    {
      "branch": "feat/models",
      "pr": 41,
      "result": {
        "action": "test",
        "duration": 58.9,
        "errors": [],
        "status": "succeeded",
        "tests": {
          "failed": 0,
          "failures": [],
          "passed": 182,
          "skipped": 2
        },
        "warningCount": 0
      },
      "sha": "a1b2c3d"
    },
    {
      "branch": "feat/presets",
      "pr": 42,
      "result": {
        "action": "test",
        "duration": 61.4,
        "errors": [],
        "status": "failed",
        "tests": {
          "failed": 1,
          "failures": [
            {
              "file": "Tests/TimerTests.swift",
              "line": 57,
              "message": "XCTAssertEqual failed: (\"25\") is not equal to (\"15\")",
              "test": "TimerTests/testPresetPersists"
            }
          ],
          "passed": 181,
          "skipped": 2
        },
        "warningCount": 0
      },
      "sha": "8a6c41e"
    }
  ],
  "introduced": {
    "TimerTests/testPresetPersists": "feat/presets"
  },
  "skipped": []
}
```

## FlowRunReport

The result of replaying a flow on one branch.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `flow` | `string` | The flow name. |
| `branch` | `string` |  |
| `sha` | `string` | Short commit SHA. |
| `steps` | `StepResult[]` | Each step: `index` (from 1), `line`, `status` (`ok`, `failed` or `skipped`), `duration`, and optional `detail`, `error`, `file` (the screenshot of a snap step). |
| `failureSnap` | `string?` | Screenshot taken when a step failed (`<flow>-failed`). |
| `video` | `string?` | Path of the recording, with `--video`. |
| `duration` | `number` | Seconds. |
| `interrupted` | `boolean?` | `true` when stopped by `proof stop` or Ctrl-C. |

```json
{
  "branch": "feat/presets",
  "duration": 7.6,
  "failureSnap": "~/.proof/sessions/Tempo/feat_presets/snaps/start-timer-failed.png",
  "flow": "start-timer",
  "sha": "8a6c41e",
  "steps": [
    {
      "duration": 2.1,
      "index": 1,
      "line": "launch",
      "status": "ok"
    },
    {
      "duration": 0.4,
      "index": 2,
      "line": "tap --id timer.start",
      "status": "ok"
    },
    {
      "duration": 5,
      "error": "no element matching #timer.running within 5s",
      "index": 3,
      "line": "expect --id timer.running",
      "status": "failed"
    },
    {
      "duration": 0,
      "index": 4,
      "line": "snap running",
      "status": "skipped"
    }
  ]
}
```

## StackFlowReport

The result of replaying a flow on every branch of a stack.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `flow` | `string` | The flow name. |
| `runs` | `BranchFlowRun[]` | Each branch: `branch`, `sha`, `build` (`succeeded`, `failed` or `skipped`), `buildErrors`, `flow` (a FlowRunReport), `changedScreens` (snap name → changed tree lines), `comparedWith` (the branch its snaps were compared with) and `pr`. |

```json
{
  "flow": "start-timer",
  "runs": [
    {
      "branch": "feat/models",
      "build": "succeeded",
      "buildErrors": [],
      "changedScreens": {
        "running": 0
      },
      "comparedWith": "develop",
      "flow": {
        "branch": "feat/presets",
        "duration": 7.6,
        "flow": "start-timer",
        "sha": "8a6c41e",
        "steps": [
          {
            "duration": 2.1,
            "index": 1,
            "line": "launch",
            "status": "ok"
          },
          {
            "duration": 0.4,
            "index": 2,
            "line": "tap --id timer.start",
            "status": "ok"
          },
          {
            "duration": 5,
            "index": 3,
            "line": "expect --id timer.running",
            "status": "ok"
          },
          {
            "duration": 0,
            "index": 4,
            "line": "snap running",
            "status": "ok"
          }
        ]
      },
      "pr": 41,
      "sha": "a1b2c3d"
    },
    {
      "branch": "feat/presets",
      "build": "failed",
      "buildErrors": [
        {
          "column": 17,
          "file": "Modules/Timer/Sources/TimerView.swift",
          "kind": "error",
          "line": 42,
          "message": "cannot find 'viewModel' in scope"
        }
      ],
      "changedScreens": {},
      "pr": 42,
      "sha": "8a6c41e"
    }
  ]
}
```

## TreeReport

The accessibility tree of the current screen.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `nodes` | `UINode[]` | Each element: `type`, `depth`, and optional `id`, `label`, `value`, `placeholder`, `enabled`, `selected`, and `frame` (`[x, y, width, height]` in points, with `--frames`). |
| `screen` | `object?` | `width` and `height` of the screen in points. |
| `rendered` | `string` | The same text the command prints without `--json`. |

```json
{
  "nodes": [
    {
      "depth": 2,
      "enabled": true,
      "frame": [
        16,
        680,
        361,
        50
      ],
      "id": "timer.start",
      "label": "Start",
      "type": "button"
    },
    {
      "depth": 2,
      "enabled": true,
      "frame": [
        16,
        740,
        361,
        50
      ],
      "id": "timer.presets",
      "label": "Presets",
      "type": "button"
    }
  ],
  "rendered": "button #timer.start \"Start\"\nbutton #timer.presets \"Presets\"",
  "screen": {
    "height": 852,
    "width": 393
  }
}
```

## AtReport

The element at a point on screen, and the step that targets it.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `element` | `UINode?` | The element found there, if any. |
| `selector` | `string[]` | The selector arguments for it, e.g. `["--id", "timer.start"]`. |
| `step` | `string` | The flow step that targets it, e.g. `tap --id timer.start`. |
| `detail` | `string?` | What happened, with `--tap` or `--as`. |
| `performed` | `boolean` | `true` when the step was performed. |

## AXScanReport

Controls in your code without an accessibility identifier.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `findings` | `AXFinding[]` | Each control: `file`, `line`, `kind` (`swiftui`, `uikit`, `ib` or `runtime`), `control` (its type) and `snippet`. |
| `filesScanned` | `number` |  |

```json
{
  "filesScanned": 148,
  "findings": [
    {
      "control": "Button",
      "file": "Modules/Timer/Sources/PresetsView.swift",
      "kind": "swiftui",
      "line": 23,
      "snippet": "Button(\"Add preset\") { model.add() }"
    }
  ]
}
```

## PRCommentsReport

Review feedback on a pull request.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `number` | `number` | The PR number. |
| `title` | `string` |  |
| `url` | `string` |  |
| `threads` | `Thread[]` | Review threads: `path?`, `line?`, `outdated`, `resolved`, and `comments` (`author`, `body`). Resolved threads only with `--all`. |
| `resolvedHidden` | `number` | How many resolved threads were left out. |
| `reviews` | `Review[]` | `author`, `state` (e.g. `CHANGES_REQUESTED`) and `body?`. |
| `comments` | `Comment[]` | Conversation comments: `author`, `body`. |

```json
{
  "comments": [],
  "number": 42,
  "resolvedHidden": 1,
  "reviews": [
    {
      "author": "reviewer",
      "body": "Close, a couple of things.",
      "state": "CHANGES_REQUESTED"
    }
  ],
  "threads": [
    {
      "comments": [
        {
          "author": "reviewer",
          "body": "Add an accessibility identifier here."
        }
      ],
      "line": 23,
      "outdated": false,
      "path": "Modules/Timer/Sources/PresetsView.swift",
      "resolved": false
    }
  ],
  "title": "Add timer presets",
  "url": "https://github.com/example/tempo/pull/42"
}
```

## PacketReport

The report for this branch.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `markdown` | `string` | The report as Markdown (also written to `report.md`). |
| `html` | `string` | The report as HTML (also written to `report.html`). |
| `summary` | `string` | One line with the report path. |

```json
{
  "html": "<!doctype html>…",
  "markdown": "# Tempo · feat/presets (8a6c41e)\n…",
  "summary": "packet → ~/.proof/sessions/Tempo/feat_presets/report.html"
}
```

## StopReport

The proof commands that were stopped.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `stopped` | `ActiveRun[]` | Each run: `pid`, `command` (the arguments after `proof`), `repo`, `branch` and `started` (seconds since 2001-01-01 UTC). |

```json
{
  "stopped": [
    {
      "branch": "feat/presets",
      "command": "flow run start-timer --stack",
      "pid": 4242,
      "repo": "Tempo",
      "started": 815000000
    }
  ]
}
```

## InstallResult

What `proof setup` installed.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `runner` | `string` | Where the runner sources were installed. |
| `skill` | `string` | Where the agent skill was installed. |
| `source` | `string` | Where they were copied from. |
